posts.author: CyberBPunk
posts.body:
Say I were to own RPG Maker 2003 and MV and I want to resize and port the Assets from 2k3 to MV but after finishing it I found it tedious and wouldn't want anyone else who wants to do the same to suffer would it be ok to post here?
Or was I not allowed to do this from the beginning despite owning both systems?

posts.author: SGHarlekin
posts.body: In case anyone else comes across this thread still looking for an answer, yes, you can share those assets. There already exists a pack that is resized XP assets on here. The terms just need to be the same as the original asset. (Gotta own the respective engine, no reselling on their own and so on)
